startUrls.title: Airbnb search URLs
startUrls.description: Paste one or more Airbnb search result URLs. Example: https://www.airbnb.com/s/Austin--TX/homes

location.title: Location (alternative to URLs)
location.description: City, neighborhood, or region. Used only if startUrls is empty. Example: Austin, TX

maxProperties.title: Maximum properties to extract
maxProperties.description: Hard cap on billable properties. Prevents runaway charges on large markets.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Defaults to BUYPROXIES94952 US datacenter.
